name: Shiori
message: "We came here like it was the most natural thing in the world, but is Ms. Librarian even here?"

name: Shiori
message: "Now that she's not bound there anymore, she might not even be in the library."

name: Shiori
message: "Well, if she's not here, we can just come back later. Shall we head in and find out?"

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, good. There she is."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...? Oh, it's you two."

name: Shiori
message: "Hello."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hello. Please take a seat."
(Take a seat)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "How have you been since then? You mentioned wanting to sort out your thoughts."

name: Shiori
message: "It's less about my thoughts, more that I'm still organizing what I remembered."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Have all your memories returned?"

name: Shiori
message: "I suppose... but the most important part is still a bit hazy."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "When you say 'the most important part,' do you mean your family?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, something like that."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Actually, I've been sorting through my thoughts since yesterday as well."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yesterday, we witnessed two ghosts disappear."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "First, the middle-aged woman at the supermarket. She remembered how she died, became aware of it, and then disappeared."

name: Shiori
message: "Yes."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And that made me wonder. If Kugayama-san had truly intended to die from those psuedo-suicide attempts, wouldn't she have disappeared then and there?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "No matter how many attempts she made, Kugayama-san never vanished. Which means she was never actually trying to die."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "What she was repeating wasn't suicide, but a performance of suicide. Wouldn't that be the case?"

name: Shiori
message: "Who knows? I wonder."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...It seems I may have spoken out of turn."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You look as though something has finally lifted. I see you've already reached your answer, Kugayama-san."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Is there anything else I can assist you with?"

name: Shiori
message: "I'm good. You've done so much for me already."

name: Shiori
message: "I just stopped by to say thanks. Thank you for everything up until now. I mean it."
(Strike a dynamic pose of extreme gratitude)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...As I said before, please don't forget that no one else can see us. Your behavior will only draw you strange looks."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...You've expressed your gratitude plenty. You're welcome. Now straighten your posture at once."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Huh? Wh-What's this all of a sudden...?"

name: Shiori
message: "It's just my buddy's way of expressing overwhelming gratitude, since the living aren't allowed to speak here."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I see. I can't say I understand, but... you're welcome."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I may not be able to help much when it comes to your family, but do reach out if anything comes up."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And if that time ever comes, you needn't thank me. Sudden, exaggerated movements can be startling."

name: Shiori
message: "Ehehe, okay. Thank you."
(Bow in gratitude)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...I suppose I should accept your gratitude once in a while. You're welcome."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I may not be able to help much when it comes to your family, but do reach out if anything comes up."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "So, what are you going to do from here on?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "From here on?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yeah. Now that you can leave the library, I was wondering if there's anything you'd like to do."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Hmm... I *have* been considering a few things, but perhaps I'll start by taking up one of my old hobbies again."

name: Shiori
message: "Oh? What kind?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Visiting secondhand bookstores. I used to wander through the town, dropping by shops I happened to come across."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I was thinking I'd start by exploring the secondhand bookstores around the area. I hope some of the books from back then are still around."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Is something the matter?"

name: Shiori
message: "Huh?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "You hesitated just now, didn't you?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please do tell me more, I'm curious."

name: Shiori
message: "Um... You've been stuck in this library for a very long time, right..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Yes, that is correct."

name: Shiori
message: "So, uh..."

name: Shiori
message: "Um, the thing is... there really aren't that many secondhand bookstores left these days... I think..."

name: Shiori
message: "And it might not just be the secondhand ones... Bookstores in general might be disappearing... There used to be one in front of the station when I was alive, but it's gone now..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see... bookstores themselves are in decline..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And e-books have become the mainstream... Time has moved on, leaving me behind..."

name: Shiori
message: "B-But hey, maybe there just aren't many bookstores around here. I'm sure there are still plenty of them in other towns. I think I've heard something like that...? Probably. Yeah."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Perhaps I should try visiting other towns, then. I've stayed here for far too long."

name: Shiori
message: "What about Tetsuya-san? Don't you want to be together with him?"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I don't plan on leaving immediately, of course. However, my tie with him has already been severed."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I won't involve myself too deeply in the lives of the living. In the end, I'm nothing more than a ghost, frozen in time."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I believe the reason I've been able to remain in this world for so long is that I've always held little interest in others."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If my regrets or fixation toward Tetsuya-san had been stronger, I might have become a wraith who spreads curses here."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "The dead should avoid involving themselves with the living as much as possible. That is likely the natural order of things."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "And besides, what I did yesterday..."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...was merely my attempt at being the person he imagined me to be."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Racking my brains, doing everything I could for my cherished friends—"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "—I have to wonder... was I able to become the protagonist he envisioned?"

name: Shiori
message: "Yes, without a doubt. I can guarantee it."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "I'm going to make the most of the time I've been given, too."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Treasure your feelings for your family. They should be what keeps you anchored to this world, Kugayama-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, I'll keep that in mind. Thank you."

name: Shiori
message: "Anyway, we should get going."

name: Shiori
message: "Goodbye, Ms. Librarian."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Goodbye, Kugayama-san."

name: Shiori
message: "Alright, now that I've said my goodbyes to Ms. Librarian, shall we head to our next stop?"
